title: How to Plan Train Travel in China
pageTitle: China Train Travel Planning Guide | KoraScale
metaDescription: Practical guidance on choosing routes, booking high-speed rail, and balancing cities for a first China trip.
excerpt: A logic-first guide to China rail: when trains beat flights, how to read routes, and what to book first.

contentBlocks.text: High-speed rail is often the most efficient way to move between major Chinese cities if your dates are fixed and stations are central to your plans.
Compare total door-to-door time, not just flight duration. Security, airport transfers, and weather delays often narrow the gap on routes under six hours by train.

faqs.question: Do I need to book China train tickets far in advance?
faqs.answer: For peak holidays, book as early as the release window allows. For regular weeks, many routes still have availability closer to departure, but seat class choice narrows.
